The NAND gate is represented by the rounded rectangular symbol and the NOT function.
DISCUSSION
The NAND gate is like the AND gate except for the NOT function.
The NOT function causes the AND gate output to invert.
A HIGH out becomes a LOW.ere...............................
The NOT function causes the AND gate to be a NOT-AND or NAND gate.
Each NAND gate has two or more inputs and a single output..
The function of a NAND gate is to determine when certain conditions are both true at the same time. A LOW out is only available when all the inputs are HIGH.
Let's look at an alarm system used to detect an open door..
When both doors are closed a HIGH is applied to each input of the NAND gate.
Two HIGHs in produce a HIGH output from the AND function.
The NOT function inverts the HIGH to a LOW making the output to the alarm a LOW.
If one door is open a LOW is applied to that input.........
A LOW and a HIGH in produce a LOW output from the AND function.
The NOT function inverts the LOW to a HIGH making the output to the alarm a HIGH.
When ALL inputs to the NAND gate are HIGH or TRUE the gate produces a LOW or FALSE output.
